scripts.ios:local: pnpm native:generate && xcodebuild -project Afilmory.xcodeproj -scheme 'Afilmory Local' -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' build
scripts.ios:production: pnpm native:generate && xcodebuild -project Afilmory.xcodeproj -scheme Afilmory -configuration Release -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' build
scripts.native:test: pnpm native:generate && xcodebuild test -project Afilmory.xcodeproj -scheme 'Afilmory Local' -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro'
